issue_context.title: Add driver that support cf1133 touchscreen controller from Sitronix
issue_context.body:
Currently Zephyr proposes no driver to support Sitronix I2C touchscreen controller.

Adding an out of tree driver that support Sitronix I2C touchscreen controller.
